releasePlan.notes: String multivariate flag (control/v1). control=off serves original GALACTIC DEFENDER welcome overlay directly; v1 shows the callsign login form first. Evaluated post-initLaunchDarkly() with fail-safe default 'control'. No prerequisite: sprite flag (invaders-shooter-sprite) is already released and independent. setPlayerName()/ldClient.identify() runs in both paths so per-player sprite targeting is unaffected by this flag's state.
